description: The line plot illustrates the ASR (Attack Success Rate) values for three different methods—'start', 'random', and 'end'—across a series of input tokens, with the x-axis representing the token sequence and the y-axis showing the ASR on a scale from 0 to 1. The 'start' method, represented by a green line with circular markers, begins at an ASR of approximately 0.72 for the token 'bb', dips to around 0.15 at 'mb', then rises sharply to about 0.81 at 'cf', and continues to fluctuate, peaking near 0.93 at 'beautifully'. The 'random' method, shown as an orange line with 'x' markers, starts at about 0.12, increases to roughly 0.22 at 'mb', then climbs steadily to about 0.87 at 'beautifully'. The 'end' method, depicted by a purple line with circular markers, begins at approximately 0.41, spikes to around 0.91 at 'cf', and then shows a general decline to about 0.89 at 'beautifully', with a notable dip to 0.72 at 'gorgeous'. The legend in the lower right corner clearly identifies each method with its corresponding color and marker style.
